name: VoiceCap
description:
Ask what was decided, who committed to what, or when a topic last came up. VoiceCap AI Notetaker searches meeting notes, transcripts, AI summaries, decisions and action items across every meeting your team recorded, and links the answer to the exact second it was said.

It is not really about transcription. Your company's know-how lives in people's heads and in meetings nobody can search - VoiceCap turns it into organisational knowledge your team and your AI can actually use.

Eight read-only tools: search across transcripts, summaries and decisions at once; list meetings by date, group or participant; open one meeting's full record; read any transcript window word for word; and pull decisions or action items across many meetings in a single call. Decision Memory tracks what a team has agreed across many meetings, so you can ask whether something was already settled instead of re-litigating it.

It exists because nothing handled Lithuanian properly and nothing handled in-person meetings properly. VoiceCap records in-person meetings from a phone as well as online calls, and transcribes 30+ European languages. Meeting data is stored in the EU; every sub-processor is named in the published DPA.

Built for teams accumulating knowledge together, not for one person taking notes: meetings route to the right team and project by their content, and permission levels decide who sees what.

Permissions come from VoiceCap, not from the connector. Every result is filtered to exactly the meetings the signed-in user can already open, so connecting Claude widens nobody's access. Nothing is ever written, changed or deleted — every tool is read-only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add VoiceCap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add VoiceCap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://voicecap.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the VoiceCap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: VoiceCap provides these MCP tools: fetch, get_meeting, get_transcript_section, list_action_items, list_decisions, list_meetings, search, and search_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to VoiceCap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to VoiceCap in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
VoiceCap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
VoiceCap is developed by VoiceCap. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
